purpose: Measure the normal per-chat manager layer omitted by direct operation-service load tests before starting large-payload sustained load
setup: Reuse the actual product-capsule fixture, explicitly warm all current sources with local MiniLM, then capture 80 fresh current chat boundaries with prepared input references
startup: sequential admission; this is not a simultaneous cold-start test
measure: actual manager PID inventory and its aggregate RSS
all relevant processes' aggregate RSS under the existing external guard
shared preparation and operation counters while the managers are idle
original head stability and actual exit of all managers
failureRule: Stop on the first failure or resource guard. Preserve partial stage samples; do not raise the bound or repeat unchanged.
doesNotEstablish: normal hook output or 98 percent evidence delivery
5 to 50 KB output ingestion capacity or eight-hour operation
p99 hooks or matched total-token improvement
